en: {fb:0580}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}In Brun, in the Esparda Empire, I found someone who'd make a perfect-o hero!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}His name is Dian Alvis, and he's a doctor who's famous around there.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}But what's really amazing about him is that he even hunts down villains! That means he has a strong sense of justice, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Angel, why not go and meet him first?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0680}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}In Garf, in Kvaal, I found someone who'd make a perfect-o hero!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}His name is Yaruru Willing, and he's a twelve-year-old boy.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}But he's a boomerang master, and get this, he has a sacred beast with him. I don't know why he's with a sacred beast, though...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Anyway, Angel, why not go and meet him first?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0780}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}In Larousse, in the Duminas Empire, I found someone who'd make a perfect-o hero!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}His name is Ryudral Algrane, and get this, he lives with dragons.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}So he can talk to dragons, and the locals respect him and call him "the Dragon's Messenger."{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}He's an amazing person, so, Angel, why not go and meet him first?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0880}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}In Tambour, in Kvaal, I found someone who'd make a perfect-o hero!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Her name is Fiana Ecliya, and she's a strong, dependable swordswoman.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}She's a bounty hunter and pretty famous in Kvaal, it seems. And they say she's actually suuuper kind.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Angel, why not go and meet her right away?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0980}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}In Gruche, the capital of the Kingdom of Fangam, I found someone who'd make a perfect-o hero!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Her name is Ashe Bradarik, and she's the kingdom's princess.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}She says sneaking out of the castle is her hobby, and she's a pretty rowdy princess, but somehow everyone adores her.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}She seems to have run away from home right now... but maybe she'll be easier to meet than at the castle? Why not go and see, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}In Nova, in the Kingdom of Kimbalt, I found someone who'd make a perfect-o hero!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Her name is Beasia Gray, and she's only sixteen, but she's the strongest martial artist around Nova.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}She's so strong that ten grown-ups ganging up on her couldn't beat her!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Angel, why not go and meet her first?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0B80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}In Trust, in the Kanoa Nation, I found someone who'd make a perfect-o hero!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Her name is Nasadia, and they say she usually works as a dancer. But, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}But her past is a total mystery. I, Florin, kinda get a whiff of "hero" off her, though...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Oh, never mind. Anyway, Angel, why not go and meet her?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0C80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}In Omron, in Kvaal, I found someone who'd make a perfect-o hero!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Her name is Tia Tangeri, and she's a girl who looks after sheep every day!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}At a glance she's just an ordinary girl, but I think she has some special power. And somehow...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Oh... never mind. Anyway, Angel, why not go and meet her?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0B80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}What's this? You want me to go there? Well, I don't mind.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I don't know the reason, but I'll go as if it's a holiday. This sort of thing is nice once in a while.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0C80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Hmph! Ridiculous. Why should I have to go to a place like that?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I have no intention of going when the purpose isn't even clear. I'm not that idle.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0D80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}What? You're telling me to go there?{n}{wait}{clear}Well, I don't mind going... but being moved around for no reason doesn't sit well with me.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0E80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}What are you scheming? I don't have so much time on my hands that I'd wander about with no purpose.{n}{wait}{clear}Anyway, I'm turning this one down. Ask the others.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1580}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I just go there?{n}{wait}{clear}Understood. I'll do it.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1680}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}No.{n}{wait}{clear}I'm not that idle either.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1780}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Understood... If I go, I'll learn the reason, then. But...{n}{wait}{clear}Fine. This time I'll do as you say.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...... Sorry, but I'll pass this time.{n}{wait}{clear}If you come again, make it about something else.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1F80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Gotcha. I just gotta go there, right?{n}{wait}{clear}Well, I ain't got nothin' special to do, so this kinda thing's fine once in a while.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}I get what you're sayin', but there ain't no reason to go there, is there?{n}{wait}{clear}Sorry, but I'm busy too. Ask me for somethin' better next time.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Got it. I just gotta go there, huh?{n}{wait}{clear}Well, ain't got nothin' else to do, so I guess this is fine once in a while.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I get it, but what's the reason for goin' there?{n}{wait}{clear}Sorry, but I'm busy too. Ask me for somethin' a little better next time. See ya.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2980}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Yes, understood, Angel. I just need to go there, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0180}{n}If you say so, Angel, I'll believe you and go.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2A80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}I understand, but... What's there?{n}{wait}{clear}It's not that I doubt you... but please ask once the purpose is a little clearer.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2B80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Yes, understood, Angel. I just need to go there, right?{n}{wait}{clear}It's your request, Angel, so it's no trouble at all.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2C80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Um... I'm really, truly sorry, but please let me pass this time.{n}{wait}{clear}I have something on my hands right now that I can't leave... I'm really sorry.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Understood. In short, I just need to go there?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}If you say so, Angel, there must be something to it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I understand, but... What's there? I don't sense anything definite.{n}{wait}{clear}You're asking quite an effort of me, so please ask once the purpose is clear.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3580}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Understood, Angel. In short, you want me to go there.{n}{wait}{clear}I don't know what you have in mind, but for now, I'll go and see.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3680}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Excuse me, but what's the purpose of going there?{n}{wait}{clear}It's not that I doubt you, but my time is precious right now. Some other time, please.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3D80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Okay, got it. I just have to go there, right?{n}{wait}{clear}I don't really get it, but anyway, I'll go and see.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3E80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I get it, but sorry, I'm pretty busy with stuff too. Let's talk about that another time, okay?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3F80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Okay, got it. I just have to go there, right?{n}{wait}{clear}It's your request, Angel, so I'll go and give it my all!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:4080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Sorry... I'm kinda busy right now. Ask me again when you really need me, okay?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:4780}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I just go there? Well, sure, I don't mind.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Traveling without thinking about anything is fun too.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Sorry. It's kinda a bad time for me. Can we do it another time?{n}{wait}{clear}Oh, it's just a little errand. I'll have it done by next time. So, sorry about this time!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:4980}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Gotcha, Angel. For now I just go there, right?{n}{wait}{clear}Traveling with no goal has always suited me, so I'll take it easy and head over.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:4A80}{n}Sorry. It's a bad time for me right now, so can we do it another time?{n}{wait}{clear}Yeah, it's just a little errand. I'll have it done by next time, so... sorry about this time!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:5180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I get it. I just have to go there, right? Well, I've got time, so sure.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Phew, isn't there some job that pays well? I'm so bored I'm getting rusty.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}If that's what it is, then some other time.{n}{wait}{clear}Sorry, but I'm busy too. I'm not so well off that I can wander around with no purpose.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:5380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Got it. I just have to go there, right? Well, I've got time, so why not.{n}{wait}{clear}Still, isn't there some decent job out there? I'm so bored my body's getting rusty.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:5480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I get it, but what am I supposed to do once I get there?{n}{wait}{clear}Sorry, but I'm busy too. Save that kind of thing for later. Thanks, my dear angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:5B80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Hmm. So I just have to go there? Sure. That much is easy.{n}{wait}{clear}But that's a weird thing to ask. Well, it sounds fun, so whatever.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:5C80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}No way, no way. Why do I have to go all the way out there?{n}{wait}{clear}If it's got nothing to do with the mission, leave me alone. I'm not just sitting around, y'know!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5D80}{n}Hmmm. So you want me to go there? Hmm, I don't really get it, but...{n}{wait}{clear}Oh well. I'm kinda curious about that area anyway. Okay, fine.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:5E80}{n}Whaaat?! What's that? Sounds like such a pain. There's other people besides me, right?{n}{wait}{clear}Jeez... Can you quit pushing people around for no reason? I'm not just sitting around either, y'know.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:6580}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Hmm. I just go there, huh? I ain't got nothin' to do, so sure.{n}{wait}{clear}Still, with jobs like this, I'm bored outta my skull.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6680}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}I get it, but is there somethin' over there? Walkin' around for no reason's just a pain.{n}{wait}{clear}Besides, I'm busy right now. Sorry, but some other time.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I get it, but is there anything there if I go?{n}{wait}{clear}Anyway, I'm in the middle of training right now, so could you lay off that stuff for a while? Thanks, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6F80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}So, I just go there? All right. If it's me you want.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}But is there something waiting there? Not that I'll pry.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:7080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}I'll pass. First of all, what would I go all that way for?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}If it's nothing important, then some other time. That's fine, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
